items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: I told him, see, you better put that cigar on out

ctx.x: No, I think he lives at 2605 St. Anthony.

2605 St. Anthony. Yeah. You know Punch-Pama looking good now? Oh yeah, Punch-It's alright. I told him, see, you better put that cigar on out, don't you start the food around there. Start to go back to smoking, because that nigga T ain't good for his system yet.
Oh, something else I was going to ask you about. Uh-huh. And that was...
